spec.title: Range
spec.description: Now: what the car says is left. At 100%: what that implies for a full battery.

spec.title: Miles per kWh
spec.description: Predicted: backed out of the car's range estimate (range ÷ battery % ÷ 52 kWh). Measured: miles driven ÷ kWh added over the trailing window.

spec.title: Saved vs petrol
spec.description: Petrol cost of the miles driven minus what the electricity actually cost.

spec.title: Running cost
spec.description: Cumulative since tracking began. Electricity is the sum of home charge costs; petrol is miles × pump price at the time.

spec.title: Cost per mile
spec.description: Electric: measured over the trailing window. Petrol: current pump price × 4.546 ÷ mpg. Needs the `mpg` key set in Redis.

spec.title: Petrol (E10)
spec.description: Wolverton Tesco, updated daily from the gov.uk Fuel Finder.

spec.title: Efficiency: predicted vs measured
spec.description: Predicted moves with driving style and weather. Measured is the real figure over the trailing window; the gap shows how optimistic the car is.

spec.title: Cost per charge
spec.description: Public charges are recorded at £0 (unknown price) and flagged by ntfy. Legend shows the total for the time range.

spec.title: Energy per charge
spec.description: From the wall = duration × 7.45 kW. Into the battery = what the car reports. The difference is charger loss.

spec.title: Charge quality
spec.description: Efficiency over 100% means the energy came in faster than the Hypervolt can deliver, i.e. not a home charge. Off-peak below 100% cost day rate.

spec.title: Miles driven
spec.description: Odometer change between runs (every 3 hours). Legend shows the total for the time range.

spec.title: Electric cost per mile
spec.description: Measured trailing-window cost per mile, so it moves with the season.
